title: Mini-Bar - displays a small status window for Time Trials and navigation
Show Mini-Bar
desc: If ON will show the Mini-Bar when in a Time Trial, else will remain hidden

title: Leave Mini-Bar open after Time Trial completed
desc: If ON will leave the bar open when you complete a race, else will close it after announcing result

title: Mini-Bar Arcade Mode
desc: If ON will show a mini-bar with scalar of 3, and reposition it to last location for the Arcade size bar

title: Mini-Bar orientation
desc: Change the orientation (horizontal vs vertical) of the mini bar-display

title: Mini-Bar Transparency
desc: Set level of transparency from 100 (semi-invisible) to 255 (opaque)

title: Mini-Bar Size Scalar (Normal Mode)
desc: Scales the size of the Mini-Bar (range = 0.5 to 4).

title: Mini-Bar Size Scalar (Arcade Mode)
desc: Scales the size of the Mini-Bar when in Arcade Mode (range = 0.5 to 4).

title: Mini-Bar Direction Arrow Placement
desc: Set which side of the Mini-Bar the direction arrow will display

title: Show Speed and Altitude
desc: If ON show your speed and altitude (handy for Time Trials)
